errors.notConfirmed: You have not confirmed your email yet: open the link we sent you.

register.title: Create your Listen account
register.intro: One account for the app and for listen-marketing.com. Inside you find Chiamarsi Producer and Chiamarsi Artisti.
register.name: Name or stage name
register.accept: I accept the Chiamarsi rules and the Listen Marketing Sagl privacy policy
register.haveAccount: Already have an account on the site? Log in
register.notePros: same credentials on the site, where the marketing happens (pages, TikTok, Talent House).
register.notePublic: app only. News, contest, hearts. No payment.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Use the same credentials as listen-marketing.com.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email: we will send you the site link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: Open the link we sent you, choose the new password on the site, then come back here to log in.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.intro: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then come back here.
confirm.resent: Email sent again. Check your spam folder too.

role.title: Who are you?
role.intro: We ask only once: it decides what you can do in the app and on the site.
role.changeNote: You can change role only by writing to Listen support.
role.confirmText: The role is chosen only once and cannot be changed from the app.

desc.producer: You upload one beat, for free. If it is among the 10 most voted it becomes a production of Chiamarsi Artisti. Same account on the site. You vote for the artists of Chiamarsi Artisti.
desc.artista: You vote for the beats and take part in Chiamarsi Artisti in your region and then nationally. Same account on the site.
desc.pubblico: You listen to beats and tracks, follow the news and give your hearts. App only, no payment.
desc.studio: Listen partner: you host the sessions and vote for beats and artists. Account verification, same profile as the site.

playlist.title: Follow the contest playlist
playlist.intro: It is required to confirm your sign-up to the app. It collects the Chiamarsi Artisti tracks distributed by Listen.
playlist.open: 1 · Open the playlist and tap Follow
playlist.missing: The playlist link is not available yet. Pull down to refresh.
playlist.step2: Come back to the app and tap “I followed it”. Until you open the link, the button stays off.
playlist.noSpotify: No connection to Spotify: the app does not ask for your account and reads nothing from Spotify, it only records that you opened the link.
playlist.greyHint: This button is grey until you open the link.
playlist.confirm: I followed it · continue in the app

update.title: Update the app
update.text: This version of Listen is no longer supported. Download the latest one from the store to continue.

hearts.moveUntilClose: You can move them until closing.
hearts.cannotVote: You cannot give hearts right now.

report.title: Report
report.intro: You are reporting “{{title}}” to Listen. The report reaches the team, who review it and can exclude the content.
report.sentText: Thank you. You can also hide it: you will no longer see it on this phone.

notifications.title: Turn on notifications
notifications.short: We notify you when the phase changes, when hearts open and before your deadlines.
notifications.intro: Notifications are only for Chiamarsi: we let you know, so you do not have to open the app to check.

items.deadlines: 7 days and 1 day before your deadlines

notifications.noAds: No advertising. You can turn them off anytime in your phone settings.
notifications.active: Notifications are on: we will let you know.
notifications.denied: Notifications are off in your phone settings: turn them back on from there.

home.weNotify: we notify you when voting opens

producer.title: Chiamarsi Producer × Artisti
producer.intro: One beat each, for free. The hearts of audience, artists and studios choose the 10 beats Chiamarsi Artisti is played on, region by region.
producer.lockNote: at the deadline beats are locked
producer.cannot: You cannot upload the beat right now: check that you completed the first launch.

waitBeats.title: Producers are delivering their beats
waitBeats.intro: Only they compete in this phase. When hearts open you can listen to the beats and give hearts to your favourites.

waitArtists.title: The artists are in the studio
waitArtists.intro: The artists record their track on one of the 10 beats. When the tracks are online you give hearts to your favourites.

preparing.title: Chiamarsi is about to start
preparing.intro: The edition is being prepared. Turn on notifications: we will tell you when it starts.

slot.title: Book your slot for Chiamarsi Artisti
slot.text: Tell us you want to be there in your region and we will let you know when sign-ups open. No payment now.
slot.bookedTitle: Slot booked · we will notify you when sign-ups open
slot.edit: Tap to review or edit your details.

pendingStudio.title: Account under review
pendingStudio.text: Listen is verifying your studio, as for agencies on the site. Meanwhile you see the waiting screen: we will notify you when it is approved.

beats.phasePill: Voting with hearts · beat delivery closed
beats.title: The beats
beats.search: Search a beat or a producer
beats.footnote: Beat delivery is closed: no new beats, no new producers. At closing, the 10 chosen beats become the productions of Chiamarsi Artisti.

top10.title: The 10 beats of Chiamarsi Producer
top10.intro: The artists of Chiamarsi Artisti record their track on these ten.
top10.notIn: Your beat is not among the 10.
top10.empty: The 10 beats have not been published yet.

apply.title: Who you are
apply.free: Taking part is free. No ID required.

beat.title: Your beat
beat.rules: WAV or MP3, at most {{maxSeconds}} seconds and {{maxMb}} MB. If you upload another one, it replaces this. At the deadline beats are locked and no new producers enter.
beat.needsApplication: First tell us who you are: stage name, city, Instagram and genre are enough.
beat.deleteText: While delivery is open you can upload another one.
beat.publish: Publish the beat in the contest
beat.saved: Beat saved: it is in the contest.
beat.noUploadUrl: The server did not provide an upload address. Try again.
beat.readOnly: Delivery is closed: the beat can no longer be edited.
beat.closedNoBeat: Beat delivery is closed and you did not upload a beat.

rejected.format: “{{name}}” was rejected: upload a WAV or MP3 file.
rejected.size: “{{name}}” ({{size}}) was rejected: the file can weigh at most {{maxMb}} MB.
rejected.duration: “{{name}}” ({{duration}}) was rejected: upload an excerpt of at most {{maxSeconds}} seconds.

tab.title: Chiamarsi Producer
tab.open: Delivery is open: you can upload, replace or delete your beat.
tab.closed: Delivery is closed: here you see your beat and its status.
tab.introProducer: Upload your beat: only one, for free. When hearts open you will find all competing beats here.
tab.introOthers: In this phase producers deliver their beats. When hearts open you will find all competing beats here.

artists.title: A track in 2 hours, in your region
artists.introBefore: Sign-ups are not open yet. If you are an artist you can book your slot: no payment now, we will let you know.
artists.introOpen: Choose the package, pay on the site and receive your sign-up code, unique and impossible to guess.

base.name: Base
base.includes: 2-hour session in a partner studio, one of the 10 beats, pre-mix by the studio, distribution of the track by Listen, participation in your region's hearts.

completo.name: Completo
completo.includes: Everything in Base, plus mix and master of the track by the studio.

artists.acceptRules: I have read and accept the Chiamarsi rules
artists.payNote: Payment happens on listen-marketing.com, in the browser: it is a real-world service (the studio session and the distribution), not an in-app purchase. Then you come back here with the code already active.
artists.noCheckoutUrl: The server did not provide the payment page. Try again.
artists.fullFallback: Seats in this region are finished: if you continue you join the waiting list.
artists.alreadyPaidText: From the site: the code is in the order email. From the app: it is already active.
artists.onlyArtists: Only accounts with the artist role sign up to Chiamarsi Artisti.
artists.finalLink: The final event and the prize

slot.title: Book your slot
slot.intro: Tell us you want to take part in your region: no payment now. We will let you know when sign-ups open, with seats and dates.
slot.email: Email (the one of your Listen account)
slot.want: I want to take part in Chiamarsi Artisti in my region
slot.updates: Keep me updated: newsletter and email, site and app notifications
slot.note: Booking costs nothing and is not the sign-up yet: it helps us count who wants to be there, region by region.
slot.doneText: You can come back here anytime to edit your details.
slot.cannot: Slot booking is not available right now.

paid.checkingText: If you paid, the sign-up code arrives in a few seconds.
paid.notYet: I do not see an active code yet
paid.notYetText: If you completed the payment it may take a few minutes: the code is also in the order email. If you did not pay, nothing was charged.

code.prefilled: You paid with this account: the code is already here.

code.chooseRegionFirst: Choose the region first to see partner studios.
code.externalSub: Not a partner: we contact them for the agreement
code.contactNote: We contact you within 48 hours to book the session: 2 hours to finish the track.

vote.search: Search a track or an artist

marketing.title: Run your next campaign with us
marketing.intro: Marketing happens on the site, not here: the Listen app is for Chiamarsi. You enter listen-marketing.com with the same account and find everything.
marketing.cardText: Pages, TikTok, Talent House: on listen-marketing.com with the same account.
marketing.publicNote: Are you audience? The site is for artists, producers and studios: if you are one, write to Listen to change role.

instagram.title: Instagram pages
instagram.text: Posts and reels on partner pages, in Italy and abroad.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.text: Your profile and hearts are anonymised and you will no longer be able to log in, in the app or on the site. Only orders remain, which Listen must keep for accounting obligations.
delete.confirmText: Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone.
